text: Once upon a time, three little pigs left home to build their own houses. The first little pig built a house of straw. One stormy night, a big bad wolf knocked on the door three times. "Little pig, little pig, let me come in!" The wolf huffed and puffed and blew the house down. The little pig ran as fast as he could to his brother's house of bricks. The wolf climbed onto the roof and slid down the chimney. He fell right into a pot of boiling water with a great splash.
